representation_fit.evidence: Brief shape is relational-web (many, high relationality; relationship is the content). Implementation is a node-link force graph of 44 nodes/68 typed directed edges (screenshots 1280x860 & 1440x900; data.js:70-149) with explicit direction semantics in the legend '箭头指向被依赖方，影响沿箭头反向传播' (source/index.html:57) and dual dependency/impact lists '影响 · 谁依赖它' / '依赖 · 它依赖谁' (source/app.js:391,396) — the canonical fit for follow-dependency/impact.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Initial screen pre-focuses the primary task: default state.focus='order', radius 1 (source/app.js:217-223); both screenshots show the central 订单服务 follow with halo rings, a plain-language impact narrative, radius selector, and a 10-row dependency list occupying the right panel while the graph fills the canvas — understand-the-relations dominates the fold.

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: title+tagline '依赖可查 · 影响可追 · 全局恒在' (index.html:15), narrative sentence '若「订单服务」不可用，半径 1 跳 内 2 个节点受影响…' rendered in panel (app.js:373-376, visible in both screenshots), legend explaining node/edge types (index.html:54-63) — what/where is conveyed within seconds of load.

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero steps to primary object at load (order focus pre-set, app.js:218); any other node is 1 action away via node click (app.js:455-460), panel row click (app.js:444-447), or search dropdown (app.js:500-518, '/' shortcut app.js:466); breadcrumb trail allows 1-click jump-back to any prior station (app.js:418-428); deep links #focus/#trail/#r supported (app.js:550-563).

context_loss.evidence: Acceptance seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' is structurally honored: refresh() only toggles highlight classes and never re-lays-out or hides the graph (app.js:254-281); dimmed nodes remain visible at opacity .13, off-state at .04 (styles.css:132-133); viewBox computed once and never clipped ('整图恒在' app.js:137-147); trail preserved with jump-back (app.js:406-428); badge '全局视图 · 跟随时整图恒在' (index.html:51, both screenshots).

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces: top bar, crumb bar, graph canvas, legend (type filter + P0 toggle), detail panel, mode badge (index.html:10-71) — all job-relevant for a 44-node relation follow; minor redundancy between narrative sentence and the two stat cards repeating the same counts (app.js:373-390) keeps this from 5.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt fails all three a11y checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size (measurement-summary.json). Source corroborates: graph nodes are SVG <g> with click handlers only, no tabindex/keyboard path to the primary object (app.js:197-213); seg buttons ~23px tall (padding 4px 10px, 11.5px font, styles.css:242-245) and legend chips ~22px (styles.css:173-178); faint text #55647a on #0f141b (styles.css:11) is low-contrast. Semantic <button>s and visible search focus ring (styles.css:63) prevent a 1.

frontend_rework.evidence: 6 of 7 receipt checks fail (layout.overflow, text.truncation, type.min_projected_size plus the 3 a11y checks; only layout.responsive_collision passes — measurement-summary.json), a strong rework signal. Corroborating sources: ellipsis truncation on rel-names (styles.css:280), 12px SVG labels inside a downscaled viewBox projecting below min size (app.js:208, styles.css:135-138). Visible layout at both viewports is otherwise composed; no gross breakage.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' is directly addressed: one-time fitted viewBox '一次算好，永不裁剪' (app.js:137-147), follow trail with station jump-back and reset (app.js:406-428), dim-not-hide highlighting (styles.css:132), badge/crumb copy '跟随时整图恒在' (index.html:33,51), and verify.ps1:44-47 exercises trail/radius deep links as evidence; first-screen data ready synchronously (app.js:564-566), satisfying the load-availability constraint.

defects_observed: Receipt: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size all fail (measurement-summary.json); graph — the primary object — is unreachable by keyboard (click-only SVG nodes, app.js:197-213)

Receipt: layout.overflow and text.truncation fail; at 1280x860 the panel's last dependency row (order.events) is cut at the viewport bottom edge requiring scroll (scrollable by design, styles.css:202), and rel-names use ellipsis truncation (styles.css:280)
Receipt: type.min_projected_size fails — 12px node labels scale down inside the fitted SVG viewBox (app.js:159,208; styles.css:135) and 9.5px chips (styles.css:281,285)

Minor inconsistency: narrative counts 2 affected nodes at radius 1 ('含 P0 ×2', screenshots; app.js:358-376 counts BFS via pub bidirectionality) while the '影响 · 谁依赖它' list shows '1 项一跳' (app.js:301-307 counts raw incoming edges only); the second node (order.events) appears under 依赖 as 发布 instead
scores.overall_note: A single-page, zero-dependency relation graph that fits the relational-web brief almost exactly: the initial screen already demonstrates the primary job (订单服务 pre-followed with typed directed edges, impact/dependency lists, radius control), following is one action from anywhere, and the graph is never removed or re-laid-out during follow — dim-to-13% opacity plus a persistent breadcrumb trail structurally satisfy the acceptance seed '关系跟随不丢失全局上下文' (app.js:254-281, styles.css:132, index.html:51). The weaknesses are executional, not conceptual: 6 of 7 receipt checks fail, with all three a11y checks (contrast, focus order, target size) corroborated by source — the SVG nodes that carry the primary task are click-only, and micro-targets/labels fall below size thresholds — plus overflow/truncation flags whose visible footprint is modest (a bottom-cut scrollable panel row, ellipsized names, small projected labels) at both 1280x860 and 1440x900. Layout is otherwise stable across viewports (layout.responsive_collision pass). Scores for task completion time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference are withheld as not observable in this blind pilot; model-judged legibility here is not human preference evidence.
